Waypoint modes and sounds

Every mode Waypoint has, how to get into it, and the sound it makes. Press a Play button to hear a sound. Choose a keyboard style to see that style's keys.

What is real and what is not. Sounds marked Waypoint sample are Waypoint's own sound files, copied into this page. Sounds marked tone are made here from the same notes, lengths and loudness as the code plays them. Where Waypoint's sound setting is "VoiceOver's" (the default), a few by-hand sounds are VoiceOver's own files instead, which this page cannot contain. Confidence tags: [Certain] read from the code, [Likely] read from the code but not tried on the Mac, [Guessing] my inference.

The four speech modes

These are not modes of use. They decide whether Waypoint speaks at all. They cycle in this order: talk, beeps, off, on demand.
